data.name: Bikash
data.long_meaning: Bikash is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'bikas' which means to cause to grow or develop. In Hindu mythology, Bikash is the name of a sage or a wise man. The name Bikash symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Bikash is a spiritual name that signifies the growth and development of the mind and intellect. It is a name that is deeply connected to the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to be the source of all knowledge and wisdom. The name is also believed to bring blessings of prosperity and success in all areas of life.
data.numerology_meaning: Bikash is a name of strength and creativity. People with this name have a natural ability to inspire others and bring about change.

in_sanskrit.name: विकाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विज्ञानमय (vijñānamaya) - having the nature of knowledge; विद्यामय (vidyāmaya) - having the nature of education; ज्ञानमय (jñānamaya) - having the nature of consciousness or awareness

in_hindi.meaning: विज्ञान, प्रज्ञा, बुद्धि (vijñāna, prajñā, buddhi) - knowledge, wisdom, intelligence
in_hindi.long_meaning: विज्ञानात्मक (vijñānātmaka) - having the nature of knowledge; विद्यात्मक (vidyātmaka) - having the nature of education; ज्ञानात्मक (jñānātmaka) - having the nature of consciousness or awareness
